quotes.text: The contacts sidebar changed from search-textbox to the shared HTML search-bar. It includes the shared template in abContactsPanel.xhtml, then uses autocomplete for directory search and prevents default form submit. The patch also changed the jar.mn line to a starred preprocessed entry so the #include expands. Current code keeps these pieces. For a new shared template include in packaged XHTML, check its jar.mn preprocessing marker as well as the element and event wiring.
